description: Surfaced by the fz-go4.18.23 audit (2026-07-02): fixture_matrix has ~27 pre-existing failures at BOTH 014aa505f and its parent on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership (byte-identical outputs at both commits — NOT caused by the recent .18.x work, but the lib-only gate means matrix state hasn't been part of recent evidence). Needs triage: which are stale oracles vs real regressions vs the known convergence bug; per project memory the matrix oracle was last restored via a legacy runtime snapshot (fz-rh2.16.6.1, dies with the old world).
